newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT -Northland Cranberries buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -Northland Cranberries buy repeated.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said she reiterated her buy rating on Northland Cranberries Inc, and raised her 12-month price target to $30 a share from $23 previously.
-- The new price target reflects a price-to-earnings multiple of 40 times Dain's fiscal 1997 estimate of $0.75 a share and about 29 times its fiscal 1998 estimate of $1.05.
-- Northland shares were down one at 22-1/2.

-- "We believe that Northland's investor base is widening significantly, as some of the growth investors that were unaware of or not interested in Northland's story a year ago are now purchasing shares," Wittenburg said in a report.
